page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Paragraphs are numbered 27 to 30 in the left margin, beside the column, and these numbers belong to the column. No marginal notes. The right edge shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: cuniæ comparare queat, juxta legem proximè praecedentem) Redemptio esto ei, (videlicet venditori) & in Jubilæo egreditor, (scilicet emptor, si ante Jubilæum redemptio fieri non potuit) Lev.25.v.29.

27. Urbium autem Levitarum, & domorum urbium possessionis eorum redemptio perpetua esto Levitis. (hoc est, quæ in divisione terræ Levitis sorte cesserunt, in civitatibus tribui Leviticæ destinatis, semper redimi poterunt, etiamsi annus à venditione sit elapsus) Qui autem emerit à Levitis, egreditor venditio domus, & urbium possessionis ejus in Jubilæo. Quia domus urbium Levitarum est possessio eorum in medio filiorum Israël, (hoc est, quia in illis consistunt facultates ipsorum, in quibus habitant, aut pecora sua alunt. Ideo carere illis non possunt (Lev.25.v.32.
28. Ager autem suburbii urbium eorum, non venditur: quia possessio perpetua est illis. Lev. 25.verf.34.

29. Mendicus in populo Dei non esto: quia benedicendo benedicet populo suo Jehovah in terra, quâ dabit illi in hæreditatem, ut possideat eam. Sed ita duntaxat, si obediendo obediat voci Jehovæ Dei sui, ita ut custodiat faciendo omne præceptum istud, quod ipse præcepit ei. Deut.15. verf.4.
30. Cum messueritis messem regionis vestræ, non finito metere angulum agri tui, & colle-ctionem

page.notes: The first line is a fragment from the previous page and stays a fragment. The paragraph numbers 27 to 30 stand in the left margin beside the column, so they are kept in the text. "esto ei" is set in italic and the words "Qui autem emerit" open in italic, as printed. The bracket "(Lev.25.v.32." is printed without a closing bracket and is left as printed. "vēditio" is read as "venditio" with a plain n. "finito" in verse 30 is a careful reading and could be checked. The word "colle-ctionem" is split across the line end with its printed hyphen.
